node.statement: Node 1.2 gives D_1 <= D_*, and the call hypothesis gives t >= 0, so D_1*t <= D_*t. Combining this scalar inequality with the preceding numerical unit estimate yields ||u_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A|| <= D_*t. This scalar weakening applies only to the displayed norm inequality; no extended D_*t-inclusion conclusion is drawn without a registered monotonicity bridge for extended inclusions.
